text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading to the Trainer's office with 
Machikane Tannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Ever since I woke up this 
morning... Did I do something unhealthy, I 
wonder...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um... No issues with recent sleep 
duration.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Her workout duration hasn't changed much 
either, and she's eating hearty meals...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
âAh, the atmospheric pressure is low 
today, so that might be the cause.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right! Once I get back to my room, 
I'll make a teru teru bozu so the weather 
clears up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Te~ru teru teru, mun mun mu~n! Please 
bring out the warm, sunny weather~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser was troubled by a 
headache for some time.
